about_the_game:
§ Predict the Next 20 Seconds — The Key to Victory

  • Every battle unfolds from an adventurer’s perspective, with each enemy action precisely displayed in one-second (one-frame) intervals. As time reveals itself like the trail of a bone serpent, the next 20 seconds become crystal clear—giving you all the information you need to anticipate, strategize, and decide when to defend or counterattack.

    The weight of each weapon directly affects the time required to swing it. If your strike overlaps perfectly with a monster’s movement, you’ll gain the upper hand—and might even trigger unexpected chain effects.

    In a battlefield where fate is laid bare, every move you make becomes a strategic step toward victory!

§ A Legendary Weapon Is Nothing Without Refinement!

  • As a legendary blacksmith, basic forging alone is never enough. A true master completes every refinement by hand—leaving nothing to chance.

    On your adventure, collect rare materials from fearsome monsters and refine, temper, and reshape them into unparalleled divine weapons.

    Every hammer strike and every blow is a testament to your journey toward greatness!

§ Forge Your Own Arsenal and Begin Your Legendary Journey!

  • It all starts with mass-produced weapons. In a resource-starved frontline base, even a legendary blacksmith can’t forge miracles without materials.

    To restore your former glory, you must rely on adventurers to gather essential resources. This allows you to research new weapon types and rebuild your village—rekindling the flames of the forge!

    As enemies become more cunning and deadly, your choices will determine your destiny.

    Will you forge a raging fire build, wielding a massive sword that turns flames into raw destruction?
    Or craft an iron fortress of ice, becoming an unbreakable shield-clad tank?

    Every weapon you forge is proof of your strength—and the beginning of your enemies' nightmares!

    Rebuilding your village is just the start—this is your path to becoming a true blacksmith legend!

§ Even a Humble Weapon Can Deliver a Deadly Blow!

  • In this game, the true power of a weapon is defined by you.

    You might begin with a simple electrified dagger, but with clever gear combinations, it can evolve into a high-speed lightning blade, annihilating enemies in an instant.

    Or perhaps you'll stack defensive attributes to forge an unstoppable tank, shrugging off any damage thrown your way.

    Here, weapon combinations are limitless—every choice reshapes the battlefield, pushing your tactics and strategy to new heights.

    No two adventures are ever the same, but every journey becomes an unforgettable legend!

§ Elemental Interactions — Every Strike Is an Act of Strategy

  • Elemental weaknesses and buffs go far beyond simple surface effects.

    Have you ever thought about dousing a burning goblin with a water attack to extinguish its flames and turn the tide?

    Or how a soaked body makes you vulnerable to a shocking blow from a wicked sea anemone’s electrified tentacles?

    Each element offers unique hit effects and can trigger powerful chain reactions through environmental interaction, creating unexpected tactical advantages.

    Every elemental clash could be the deciding factor—turning strategy and creativity into your ultimate weapons

§ The Village — More Than Just a Resting Place!

  • In this game, the village is far more than a place to rest.

    Explore the knowledge-filled library, find peace in the sacred chapel, or stumble upon surprises in the mysterious little shop. Beyond forging weapons and slaying monsters, there’s a deep talent system, collectible elements, and a robust quest system, offering layers of strategic choices for your journey.

    Every visit brings new discoveries—your legendary tale never stops unfolding!

§ The Endless Path of Forging — Strategy and Creativity at Their Peak

  • In this world, strategy is power, and every weapon you hold is the beginning of limitless possibilities.

    Through countless build combinations and daring experiments, even the most ordinary weapon can become a legendary blade, turning hopeless situations into moments of triumph.

    This is more than a game—it’s the ultimate test of ingenuity and strategy.

    Grab your hammer, embark on the Path of Gear, and forge your own legend!

name: Path of Gear: Blacksmith's Legend

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 2.0GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Support for OpenGL 3
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: “Path of Gear: Blacksmith's Legend” is a deck-building Roguelite where you play as a blacksmith, crafting unique weapons from materials found in battles, events, and the environment. Each run offers new weapon builds and playstyles to face monsters.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
